hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Find the top-left coordinate of a submatrix in board that matches pattern under bijection.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Pattern digits must match exact board values, while letters have a one-to-one mapping with board digits.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Iterate over all valid top-left cells (r, c) in row-major order. Check for valid bijective mapping and return the first match.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct submatrix scan with bijective map validation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive search over board positions is optimal for small matrices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for 10-digit bijection maps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce strict bijection between characters and digits.
